contents.description: A `Tensor` of type `string`. 0-D. The encoded image bytes.

channels.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `0`. Number of color channels for the decoded image. dtype: The desired DType of the returned `Tensor`.

expand_animations.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `True`. Controls the shape of the returned op's output. If `True`, the returned op will produce a 4-D tensor for all GIFs and WebP images, animated or not, and a 3-D tensor in all other cases. If, `False`, the returned op will produce a 3-D tensor for all file types and will truncate animations to the first frame.

output.description: `Tensor` with type `dtype` and a 3- or 4-dimensional shape, depending on the file type and the value of the `expand_animations` parameter.
